name: Pyhar
source:
Pyhar is the Unfortunate Harpy. As one of the "unfortunate monsters", she is a bird with human legs. She is also occasionally on the lookout for "hot guys". 

[From [url=https://mgq.miraheze.org/wiki/Pyhar]Mon-musu Quest Wiki[/url]]
